description: Azure Well-Architected Framework (WAF) Assessment Scoring Configuration

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.description: Ability of a system to recover from failures and continue to function
reliability.assessment: How well your Landing Zone supports workload availability and resilience

checks.name: Network Redundancy
checks.description: Multiple VNets with peering supports workload resilience
checks.passMessage: ✓ Network redundancy through multiple VNets with peering supports workload resilience
checks.failMessage: ✗ Limited network architecture - consider implementing hub-spoke for better availability

checks.name: Resource Protection
checks.description: Resource locks protect critical infrastructure from accidental deletion
checks.passMessage: ✓ Resource locks protect critical infrastructure from accidental deletion
checks.failMessage: ✗ No resource locks - critical resources are at risk of accidental deletion

checks.name: Hybrid Connectivity
checks.description: VPN or ExpressRoute provides redundant access paths
checks.passMessage: ✓ Hybrid connectivity (VPN/ExpressRoute) provides redundant access paths
checks.failMessage: ⚠ No hybrid connectivity detected - may impact disaster recovery capabilities

security.name: Security
security.description: Protection against security threats and data breaches
security.assessment: Evaluation of security controls and threat protection measures

checks.name: Policy Enforcement
checks.description: Strong policy governance for security compliance
checks.passMessage: ✓ Strong policy enforcement with {policyAssignmentCount} policy assignments
checks.failMessage: ✗ Weak policy governance - implement Azure Policy for security compliance

checks.name: Access Control
checks.failMessage: ✗ Limited access control - expand RBAC implementation

checks.name: Network Segmentation
checks.description: Network Security Groups for network-level protection
checks.failMessage: ✗ No NSGs detected - implement network-level security

checks.name: Firewall Protection
checks.description: Azure Firewall for centralized security filtering
checks.passMessage: ✓ Azure Firewall deployed for centralized security filtering
checks.failMessage: ⚠ No Azure Firewall - consider deploying for egress traffic control

costOptimization.name: Cost Optimization
costOptimization.description: Managing costs while maximizing cloud value
costOptimization.assessment: Cost management practices and financial governance

checks.name: Budget Management
checks.failMessage: ✗ Insufficient cost controls - implement budgets for all subscriptions

checks.name: Cost Tracking
checks.passMessage: ✓ Resource tagging enables cost tracking and chargeback
checks.failMessage: ✗ Limited tagging - implement mandatory tags for cost allocation

checks.name: SKU Controls
checks.description: Policy enforcement to prevent expensive deployments
checks.passMessage: ✓ Policies can prevent deployment of expensive resource SKUs
checks.failMessage: ⚠ No policy enforcement - consider policies for SKU restrictions

operationalExcellence.name: Operational Excellence
operationalExcellence.description: Operations processes that keep systems running in production
operationalExcellence.assessment: Organizational and governance structure for operations

checks.name: Management Hierarchy
checks.passMessage: ✓ Management group hierarchy ({mgCount} groups) enables organized governance
checks.failMessage: ✗ Flat structure - implement management group hierarchy

checks.name: Subscription Strategy
checks.passMessage: ✓ Multiple subscriptions support workload isolation and scale
checks.failMessage: ⚠ Limited subscription strategy - consider subscription democratization

checks.name: Monitoring & Logging
checks.passMessage: ✓ Diagnostic settings enable monitoring and logging

performanceEfficiency.name: Performance Efficiency
performanceEfficiency.description: Ability to scale resources to meet demand efficiently

checks.name: Scalable Network
checks.description: Hub-spoke topology for efficient connectivity at scale
checks.passMessage: ✓ Hub-spoke network topology enables efficient connectivity at scale
checks.failMessage: ✗ Network architecture may not scale efficiently

checks.name: High-Performance Connectivity
checks.failMessage: ⚠ No ExpressRoute - VPN may limit bandwidth for workloads

checks.name: Deployment Automation
checks.failMessage: ⚠ Manual governance may slow deployment velocity

notes: This configuration defines the Well-Architected Framework assessment for Azure Landing Zones.
Each pillar has checks that evaluate specific aspects of your environment.
Scores are calculated as a percentage of passed checks per pillar.
The overall WAF score is the average of all five pillar scores.
You can adjust weights, conditions, and messages to match your organization's WAF interpretation.
